result.instructions: Tools for Vtiger, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which leads are marked Hot and who owns them?"; "Find the contact with the email jane@example.com and show her open deals."; "How many open cases do we have for Acme Corp?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vtiger data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vtiger_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vtiger_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vtiger_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vtiger_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vtiger_get_me
tools.title: Get the connected user
tools.description: The Vtiger user the credentials belong to (id, user name, name, email). GET /me.

tools.name: vtiger_list_modules
tools.title: List modules
tools.description: The CRM modules this user can access (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Potentials, Cases, ...) with label and whether each holds records. GET /listtypes.

tools.name: vtiger_describe_module
tools.title: Describe a module
tools.description: A module's fields (name, label, type, mandatory, editable, reference targets, picklist values) and whether it can be created, updated or deleted. Read this before creating or filtering. GET /describe?elementType=<module>.

module.description: Module name, for example Contacts, Accounts, Leads, Potentials (deals), Cases, Calendar (tasks and events). Names come from vtiger_list_modules.

tools.name: vtiger_list_records
tools.title: List or search records
tools.description: Records of one module, optionally filtered (all filters AND-ed), sorted and paged. Builds a SELECT for GET /query. The vendor returns at most 100 records per call; pass next_offset as offset for the next page. Name the fields you need: a full record has 100+ fields.

module.description: Module name, for example Contacts, Accounts, Leads, Potentials (deals), Cases, Calendar (tasks and events). Names come from vtiger_list_modules.

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: vtiger_count_records
tools.title: Count records
tools.description: How many records of a module match the filters (same filters as vtiger_list_records). GET /query with count(*).

module.description: Module name, for example Contacts, Accounts, Leads, Potentials (deals), Cases, Calendar (tasks and events). Names come from vtiger_list_modules.

tools.name: vtiger_query
tools.title: Run a SELECT query
tools.description: Run your own read-only query: SELECT <fields|*|count(*)> FROM <Module> [WHERE ...] [ORDER BY ...] [LIMIT offset,count]. One module only, no joins, no grouping brackets; at most 100 records per call. Only SELECT is accepted. GET /query.

query.description: Example: select id,firstname,lastname from Contacts where mailingcity = 'Boston' or mailingcity = 'Austin' order by createdtime desc limit 0,25

tools.name: vtiger_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: One record with all its fields, by id (for example 4x2063). GET /retrieve?id=<id>.

id.description: Record id of the form <moduleTypeId>x<recordId>, for example 4x2063.

tools.name: vtiger_lookup
tools.title: Find records by email or phone
tools.description: Find records in one or more modules by an exact email address or phone number. GET /lookup.

value.description: The email address or phone number.

modules.description: Modules to search (default Contacts, Leads, Accounts).

items.description: Module name, for example Contacts, Accounts, Leads, Potentials (deals), Cases, Calendar (tasks and events). Names come from vtiger_list_modules.

annotations.title: Find records by email or phone

tools.name: vtiger_list_related_modules
tools.title: List related modules
tools.description: The modules a module can be related to (for example Accounts relate to Contacts, Potentials, Cases, Documents). GET /relatedtypes?elementType=<module>.

module.description: Module name, for example Contacts, Accounts, Leads, Potentials (deals), Cases, Calendar (tasks and events). Names come from vtiger_list_modules.

tools.name: vtiger_get_tags
tools.title: Get a record's tags
tools.description: The tags on one record. GET /tags_retrieve?id=<id>.

id.description: Record id of the form <moduleTypeId>x<recordId>, for example 4x2063.

tools.name: vtiger_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: WRITE: create one record in a module (a lead, contact, account, deal, case, ...). Send every mandatory field (vtiger_describe_module lists them; assigned_user_id is usually mandatory, use the id from vtiger_get_me). Returns the new record. POST /create. Not retried.

module.description: Module name, for example Contacts, Accounts, Leads, Potentials (deals), Cases, Calendar (tasks and events). Names come from vtiger_list_modules.

fields.description: Field values keyed by field name (see vtiger_describe_module). Reference fields take a record id like 3x12; picklists take the exact value.

tools.name: vtiger_update_record
tools.title: Update fields of a record
tools.description: WRITE: change only the named fields of an existing record (the vendor's revise call; other fields stay as they are). Returns the updated record. POST /revise. Not retried.

id.description: Record id of the form <moduleTypeId>x<recordId>, for example 4x2063.

fields.description: Field values keyed by field name (see vtiger_describe_module). Reference fields take a record id like 3x12; picklists take the exact value.

tools.name: vtiger_add_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a record
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to one record (existing tags stay). POST /tags_add. Not retried.

id.description: Record id of the form <moduleTypeId>x<recordId>, for example 4x2063.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Vtiger
prompts.description: What you can do with Vtiger here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_leads_by_rating_or_owner
prompts.title: Review leads by rating or owner
prompts.description: The AI reads the module's fields and picklist values, then lists and counts leads filtered by fields such as rating, source or owner.

prompts.name: find_a_customer_by_email_or_phone
prompts.title: Find a customer by email or phone
prompts.description: The AI finds contacts, leads or organizations by an exact email address or phone number and opens the full record.

prompts.name: report_on_open_deals_and_cases
prompts.title: Report on open deals and cases
prompts.description: The AI checks the module's fields, then runs read-only SELECT queries on it, for example deals by stage or open cases of an organization, up to 100 records per call.

prompts.name: add_a_lead_and_tag_it
prompts.title: Add a lead and tag it
prompts.description: The AI checks the mandatory fields, creates the lead assigned to you, and tags it, for example with the name of an event.

prompts.name: update_records_after_a_call
prompts.title: Update records after a call
prompts.description: The AI opens the record, then changes only the fields you name, such as a deal's stage or a case's status, and leaves the rest as it is. Nothing is deleted.
